research_line: FKP-16 real Memory Gym action-value source successor
question: Can high-first real 128-step physical action schedules produce goal and delayed-action-value headroom unavailable to prior H16 fixed-macro controls, in already-consumed TRAIN/VALIDATION worlds, to justify a distinct later trained temporal world model?
hypothesis: Longer public action sequences and reward-conditioned schedule switches may generate genuine goals where 16-step choices failed, but could also fail. Preserve null.

cohorts.policy: All 16 selected world seeds consumed in FKP16 original training/validation. New H128 physical outcomes are public TRAIN/VAL development source exposure, NOT independent/blinded scientific DEV.

actions.alternating: k in 0..8 alternates k and (k+4)%9 every eight steps
actions.blind_random: 3 fixed seed+anchor+plan numeric PRNG source-blind 8-step macro sequences
actions.feedback: 3 public-feedback eight-step switch policies: init (seed+anchor//16+variant)%9, hold action for next block only if previous block contains positive reward, else rotate by 1+variant modulo9
actions.physical: Reset actual original source and replay exact same public prior prefix for EVERY plan, then execute up to 128 source.step actions. Readout 16/32/64/128 from one actual trajectory, stop at native terminated/truncated. No counterfactual predictions or privileged source info used by policy.

metrics.fit_plan_selection: best single global 128step return plan selected by mean on FIT eight worlds only, then frozen for AUDIT
metrics.upper_bounds: best of nine constant and best of all24 per anchor AFTER public outcomes, explicitly privileged ORACLEs
metrics.primary: on AUDIT eight previously consumed VAL worlds: real return, goal event and distinct goal worlds vs H16; oracle24−fit_selected_fixed_plan mean return, paired world bootstrap 10000 seed9090
metrics.positive_source_signal: At H128 2 or more distinct AUDIT worlds, at least 4/32 AUDIT anchors with genuine native goal events among 24 physically tested policies, AND oracle24 minus FIT-best globally fixed plan >=+0.15 real return with world-cluster CI lower>0
metrics.secondary: Positive/negative genuine public reward event counts, per-horizon physical action-count and survival, paired H16 vs H128 hindsight return and native goal fractions, exact source SHA/trace, cross-OS replay
metrics.no_go: If no/too few goals, low recoverable action return, mismatched source, preserve negative; do not change actions/horizons/seeds or analysis after seeing outcomes
metrics.science_scope: This is source-only and the global FIT-selected fixed macro is a conventional simple control. Even positive is SOURCE_HEADROOM_DEV_ONLY, NEVER SCIENTIFIC_PASS; no trained GRU parity, independent OOD, genuine native model learning, retention or efficient autonomous planning proof.

qualification: First Git commit prereg ONLY, then original source code/fixture tests. G29 generated artifacts and exact source SHA/tree pin. Both Ubuntu/Windows focused and FULL 54 root regression before original H128 source first-use; one original Linux source run and Windows deterministic replay of same already-consumed world seeds, no protected first-use.
